decisions.statement: What a tool carried is no part of what the agent wrote.
A line the person's own prompt made is the only line read as the person's words.
What the person wrote is read past every word the agent wrote after it.
What a subagent wrote is no part of what the agent wrote.
A tail opening partway through a line is read from the next whole line.
A turn the agent closed with a tool call and no words answers nothing.

definition: the words each side wrote last in a transcript
